title: A Reasonably Good Tree for the Price…
text:
A Reasonably Good Tree for the Price…. [[VIDEOID:f0f9b5743c257bb128e6cfb05389280d]] Here is this economy budget friendly tree. As you can see, it is not as nice as the pictures, but I wasn’t expecting a lot. With some extra ornaments and decorations it is suitable. I was a little disappointed with the snow tips, not as nice as I was expecting. The tree doesn’t look full and the top does gets bare.

Overall, it is nice for our first tree reasonably priced.

Trust you found this review honest and helpful:-)
